entry_points.summary: Appends structured JSON event to run events.jsonl and repo-wide metrics.jsonl; flock-safe; sources plan-path.sh.
Sugar over log-event.sh; start/end/wrap modes emit <phase>_start/_end with wall_ms; python3 ms-timestamp fallback for macOS; anomaly detection via check_wall_ms.
Anomaly guard: emits telemetry_anomaly (reason wall_ms_overflow >604_800_000ms or wall_ms_negative) and returns 1 to suppress bogus *_end event; called from end and wrap modes.
Scans docs/llm/*.json, collects memories[], sorts by slug asc/date desc, writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically via os.replace.
Emits JSON blob with plugin git SHA, dirty flag, branch, optional tag; resolves plugin root via four env vars.
Gate script for memory-review agent; <RUN> <parent_command>; 4-state terminal taxonomy; 5-line stdout contract on ready.
CLI: extracts dismissed finding signatures from consecutive archive run pairs; --global and --filename flags; outputs {signatures,n_runs_scanned}.
Pairwise algorithm: R_i snapshot vs R_{i+1}.previous-* user-edited copy to find dismissed findings.
Rsync local tree to two-level remote layout: <slug>/base/ (seeded once, atomic mkdir lock) + <slug>/<task-id>/ overlay via --link-dest; REMOTE_HOME resolved via SSH printf; SLUG/TASK_ID validated.
Acquires remote lock via mkdir, seeds shared base via rsync, writes .base-ready marker with HEAD SHA, releases lock; losers poll up to 600s.

Layered TOML config loader; subcommands: get, export-env, ensure-defaults, explain, should-notify, list-question-ids, resolve-question, check-no-ask, set, migrate; QUESTION_IDS registry + RESULT_MAP; startup guards at module load.
Module-load guard: asserts QUESTION_IDS keys exist in VALIDATORS, have skill_default, RESULT_MAP choices are valid; exits 2 on violation.
Prints sorted JSON array of registered question IDs from QUESTION_IDS registry.

Returns JSON resolver envelope {result,default,source,rule_id,strength,reason,sources}; consults 4-layer config then routing-preference memories; honors Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL, Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK, Z_HARNESS_EXPLAIN_RESOLUTION; post-processes via _apply_overnight_overrides.
Returns JSON {result:halt|proceed, question_id, rule_id}; fail-closed gate for overnight mode; unregistered qids always halt with unknown_ask_blocked event.
Atomic read-modify-write of config key in global or project TOML; validates key+value before writing; exit 2 on validation, 4 on I/O.
Thin shell wrapper: exec python3 scripts/config.py "$@".

Classifies terminal state of a run as clean|halted|errored|unknown; subcommands: classify <run-id-or-path> [--command <name>], last-event <run-id-or-path>; sources plan-path.sh; supports canonical and legacy layouts.
Matches event kind against clean allowlist, halt allowlist, and *_error/fatal pattern; returns one of four terminal states.
Subcommand entry; implement-all special case: requires last event=implement_end|compaction_pause AND all TASKS.md checkboxes [x]|[~] for clean.
Resets - [~] in-progress markers to - [ ] in <plan-dir>/TASKS.md; atomic via .tmp.$$ rename; always exits 0; --self-test mode with 4 assertions.
Audits AskUserQuestion callsites in commands/ and skills/; tags REGISTERED (file also has resolve-question or check-no-ask) or UNREGISTERED; --strict exits 1 on unregistered.
Phase-0 preflight for /z-overnight; check-collisions --chain <steps> --base <dir>: exits 0 if safe, emits slug_collision_halt event and exits 1 on collision; --self-test runs 8 assertions.
v1 rule (SPEC C13): collision when first chain step is plan|research AND <base>/PLAN.md exists; cds to REPO_ROOT before calling log-event.sh.
Locates latest overnight run dir, loads overnight-state.json + events.jsonl, calls generate_report, writes MORNING_REPORT.md atomically; exits 1 on I/O or parse error.

Assembles five sections: chain summary (HEAD SHA mismatch banner), phase results table, unilateral decisions table, test outcomes, recommended next (branches on halt reason: no_ask_blocked, slug_collision_halt, skill_tool_failure, generic).
Golden-file comparison against fixtures in z-harness/overnight-run/tests/morning-report-fixtures/; runs root fixture + subdirs with MORNING_REPORT.md.golden.
Local pre-commit/pre-PR harness; runs lint-askuser.sh --strict; maps exit 1 to advisory warning, propagates exit 2+ as hard failures.

End-to-end smoke tests for config.py; 18+ test classes with hermetic XDG_CONFIG_HOME temp dirs; covers defaults, env overrides, repo-local precedence, schema errors, ensure-defaults, export-env dedup, resolve-question, overnight overrides, check-no-ask, list-question-ids, 3-level nesting (roles.*), migrate, _KEY_RE.
Bash regression harness for log-phase.sh; 4 TEST groups, 21 assertions; hermetic via Z_HARNESS_PLANS_DIR+Z_HARNESS_SLUG temp dirs; covers overflow, normal path, negative wall_ms, 26h false-positive.

invariants: All scripts require python3 for JSON handling, timing fallbacks, and document generation.
All scripts resolve the repo root via git rev-parse or pwd fallback.
log-event.sh and log-phase.sh honor Z_HARNESS_SLUG for slug-namespaced vs. legacy flat plan layout.
log-event.sh sources scripts/plan-path.sh for canonical and legacy plan path resolution.
log-phase.sh check_wall_ms emits telemetry_anomaly and suppresses *_end event when wall_ms > 604_800_000ms (overflow) or wall_ms < 0 (clock skew); exits 0 in both anomaly cases.
regenerate-memories-flat.py writes MEMORIES-FLAT.md atomically via os.replace on a PID+random-suffixed temp file.
run-memory-review.sh always exits 0; skip conditions are communicated via STATUS: line on stdout.
run-memory-review.sh accepts exactly two positional args: <RUN> <parent_command>.

run-memory-review.sh stdout line 1 is always STATUS: ready | STATUS: skipped <reason>; lines 2-4 are diff, SPEC (or empty), TAGS paths when ready; line 5 is DEBUG.md path when parent_command is debug.

run-memory-review.sh emits exactly one memory_review_terminal event on all skip paths using a 4-state taxonomy: skipped_broken_context, not_applicable, ready (orchestrator-owned), dispatched (orchestrator-owned).
extract-dismissals.py outputs JSON {signatures, n_runs_scanned} to stdout; exit 0 even when no dismissals found.
extract-dismissals.py --global applies the pairwise algorithm within each slug independently, not across slugs.
The env var for the plan base dir is Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR (singular, not PLANS_DIR).
config.py _run_startup_guards() runs at module load and exits 2 on any QUESTION_IDS/VALIDATORS/RESULT_MAP inconsistency.
config.py resolve-question returns a JSON envelope with result in {ask, skip, prefill, halt} (resolver result-domain); RESULT_MAP handles option-to-result translation.
config.py resolve-question stdout is reserved for the JSON envelope; all diagnostics route to stderr.
config.py resolve-question exits 5 when Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 and Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt are both set.
config.py check-no-ask is fail-closed: unregistered question_ids return halt when Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt.
config.py set performs atomic read-modify-write via temp-file rename; validates key format and value against VALIDATORS before writing.
config.py export-env emits config_resolved event at most once per Z_HARNESS_RUN via O_EXCL stamp file in TMPDIR.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh two-level layout: base/ seeded once per slug with atomic remote mkdir lock; per-task overlay uses --link-dest for hard-linked unchanged files.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh resolves REMOTE_HOME via ssh printf (tilde expansion unreliable in --link-dest).
remote-sandbox-sync.sh TASK_ID rejects the literal value 'base' and all path-traversal patterns.
run-status.sh always exits 0; terminal state is communicated as a printed string on stdout.
run-status.sh classify with --command implement-all requires both a clean last-event kind AND all TASKS.md checkboxes [x]|[~] before returning clean.
normalize-task-state.sh always exits 0 (best-effort); no events emitted.
normalize-task-state.sh only rewrites the - [~] prefix; - [ ] and - [x] markers are never modified.
overnight-preflight.sh check-collisions exits 0 when the chain's first step is not plan or research, regardless of artifacts.
overnight-preflight.sh cds to REPO_ROOT before calling log-event.sh to ensure canonical path resolution regardless of caller cwd.
morning-report.py writes MORNING_REPORT.md atomically via tempfile + os.rename; exits 1 on missing overnight-state.json.
morning-report.py finds the latest run by lexical sort of directories containing '-overnight-' in the archive dir.
lint-askuser.sh classification is file-level: all AskUserQuestion callsites in a file tagged REGISTERED if the file also contains resolve-question or check-no-ask anywhere.
preflight.sh maps lint-askuser.sh exit 1 to advisory warning; exit 2+ propagates as hard failure.
gotchas: log-phase.sh check_wall_ms threshold 604_800_000ms catches seconds-vs-ms overflow (1500x headroom) while allowing sessions up to 7 days; wall_ms_negative covers NTP jumps / clock skew.

config.py startup guards check: every QUESTION_IDS key exists in VALIDATORS; every entry has non-null skill_default; every RESULT_MAP (question_id, choice) references known question_id and valid choice.
config.py resolve-question: Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 short-circuits to result=ask regardless of config/memory; Z_HARNESS_EXPLAIN_RESOLUTION=1 enables verbose stderr explain output.
config.py resolve-question: Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt activates _apply_overnight_overrides; allowlist hits return overnight_decision envelope; non-allowlist hits return halt envelope.
config.py resolve-question reads routing-preference memories from docs/llm/*.json (harness-repo-relative, not project-relative); project scope filtering uses Z_HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT or git rev-parse.
config.py resolve-question conflict resolution: config non-default AND memory disagrees -> result=ask source=conflict; multiple disagreeing memory entries also -> result=ask source=conflict.
config.py resolve-question strength mapping: very_strong memory -> skip; strong or weak memory -> prefill (when config is at default ask).
config.py check-no-ask: unregistered question_id always halts (fail-closed) and emits unknown_ask_blocked event when Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt.
config.py set default scope is project; pass --scope=global for global config; uses require_exists=False so it creates the file if absent.
config.py global layer validation failures emit WARNING and fall back to default (soft fail); repo/env layer failures exit 2 (hard fail).

run-memory-review.sh 4-state terminal taxonomy: skipped_broken_context (missing_args, no_plan_dir, tags_missing), not_applicable (empty_diff, all_tasks_skipped, debug_md_missing); ready and dispatched are orchestrator-owned.
run-memory-review.sh parent_command=debug adds third skip condition: STATUS: skipped debug_md_missing if DEBUG.md absent or unreadable; state=not_applicable.
run-memory-review.sh _build_terminal_payload has a pure-bash JSON fallback for environments without python3.
macOS BSD date lacks %3N support; log-phase.sh falls back to python3 time.time()*1000.
log-event.sh silently wraps non-JSON payloads as {"raw": ...} instead of failing.
log-event.sh mid-flight legacy detection: writes to old flat path if run dir already exists there.
run-memory-review.sh disables pipefail around git diff | head -n 5000 to tolerate SIGPIPE.
version.sh degrades gracefully if plugin root is not a git repo, returning non-git sentinel values.
extract-dismissals.py drops findings lacking a title field; does NOT fall back to T-MR-NNN ids (renumbered each run, would produce spurious dismissal matches).
extract-dismissals.py --filename allows targeting PLAN_STYLE_AUDIT.md instead of the default MR-REVIEW.md.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh warns but does not fail when no .z-harness-rsync-exclude is found.
remote-sandbox-sync.sh seed_base: failed rsync cleans up partial base dir before releasing lock to avoid a dangerously incomplete base.
run-status.sh classify --command implement-all: a TASKS.md with zero checkboxes is treated as incomplete (guards against wrong TASKS.md path).
run-status.sh last-event reads the last 20 lines of events.jsonl, iterating in reverse to find the latest valid JSON line.

morning-report.py _build_recommended_next: halt reason no_ask_blocked or unknown_ask_blocked shows lint-askuser.sh remediation steps with question_id; slug_collision_halt shows conflicting artifact and slug; skill_tool_failure shows captured error message.
morning-report.py emits CRITICAL HEAD SHA mismatch banner when head_sha_mismatch_at_resume event found in events.jsonl.
overnight-preflight.sh uses Z_HARNESS_SLUG env var for the slug in the emitted event; falls back to basename of --base if unset.
lint-askuser.sh --strict makes the script advisory-fail for CI; the default (no --strict) always exits 0 regardless of findings.
preflight.sh is documentation/audit tooling, not runtime enforcement; unregistered AskUserQuestion callsites under Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt still block until the user responds.
